title: The D23 correctness comparison runs on at least 100 paired units with a McNemar verdict
body:
Why: on the valid protocol (evals/d23/harness.ts overlay, interface paragraph) K scores 2/16 vs P 3/16 paired (.krn/runs/d23-comparison/regrade-iface2); research (.krn/runs/d23-comparison/research.md) puts a detectable +15pp paired win at ~80-150 units, so 20 units cannot show K beating P.
Outcome: a unit selector in evals/d23/ picks at least 100 merged KRN pull requests whose tests fail on the parent and pass on the merge under the harness overlay, and the replay+regrade runs on them for both arms; the summary line adds an exact McNemar p-value on the discordant pairs.
Proof: node evals/d23/regrade.ts prints 'paired K x/n, P y/n, McNemar p=...' with n >= 80.
Scope: evals/d23/, test/evals/, .krn/runs/d23-comparison/.
